findings.title: No automated tests accompany a redaction/bundling script
findings.body: tools/dcp/build_comprehensive_bundle.py is 372 lines including secret-pattern redaction, JSON key-based redaction, path classification, and manifest generation, but the diff contains no test file. This is exactly the kind of logic (regex-based secret redaction, inclusion/exclusion boundaries) where a silent regression would leak a local path or credential-shaped value into a bundle intended for external upload. Recommend at least unit tests for redact()/redact_json_value()/safe_copy() extension gating.

findings.title: Schema self-check conflates missing jsonschema dependency with real schema failure
findings.body: In build(), `import jsonschema` runs inside the per-file loop and any exception (including ImportError if jsonschema isn't installed in the execution environment) is caught by the broad `except Exception` and recorded as `{"status": "FAIL", "error": str(exc)}` in VALIDATION_REPORT.json's schema_self_checks. A reader of the audit bundle could misread an environment/dependency gap as an actual invalid schema in the repo.

findings.title: Local-path redaction misses macOS's actual default TMPDIR pattern
findings.body: REDACTIONS covers /Users/, /home/, /private/tmp/, and Windows C:\Users\, but not macOS's real per-user temp root /var/folders/... (what $TMPDIR actually resolves to on macOS, as opposed to /private/tmp/). Given the bundle already labels secret_scan as PATTERN_REDACTION_ONLY and the candidate file roots are curated docs/contracts/schemas/proof directories rather than arbitrary temp output, this is a narrow, already-disclosed gap rather than a live leak vector.

findings.title: safe_copy() creates destination directories even for excluded non-text files
findings.body: safe_copy() calls dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) before checking whether the file's extension is copyable. For files that fall into the final `else: return False, "excluded non-text artifact"` branch, this leaves empty directories in the audit bundle tree. Cosmetic only — MANIFEST.json still correctly marks these EXCLUDED.

findings.title: PACKET_PROOF_INDEX.packet_roots is file-level, not deduplicated packet identifiers
findings.body: packet_roots is built from full manifest source paths under task-packets/ (e.g. both the .md and .json for the same packet appear as two separate entries), so despite the key name it is not a deduplicated list of packet roots. Naming nit only; proof_roots in the same object is correctly deduplicated via rel(p).split("/")[1].

remaining_risks: No test coverage exists for the redaction/inclusion logic in this diff.
Schema self-check false-FAILs are possible if jsonschema is absent from the execution environment.
Pattern-based secret/path redaction is explicitly non-exhaustive (macOS /var/folders/ temp paths uncovered); acceptable given the narrow, curated source-root scope and the bundle's own disclaimer.
